text: Reliable information from a colleague who knows this system (it is correct): the law is a sum of 3 terms. Each term is a constant times one factor, or a constant times a product of two factors that depend on different inputs. In the forms below each c is a different unknown constant. 2 of the terms are exactly of these forms: `c*(1/(1 + c*eps))*(T**3)` and `c*(np.log(1 + eps)**2)`.
